question: Among the patients with a normal blood glucose, how many of them don't have thrombosis?
evidence: normal blood glucose refers to GLU < 180; don't have thrombosis refers to Thrombosis = 0;
clarification: Count each distinct ID only once.
gold: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.GLU < 180 AND T3.Thrombosis = 0
gold0: SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.GLU < 180 AND T3.Thrombosis = 0

c.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient AS p JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID WHERE l.GLU < 180 AND e.Thrombosis = 0;

d.request: How many distinct patient IDs have GLU < 180 and Thrombosis = 0?
d.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Examination AS e ON l.ID = e.ID WHERE l.GLU < 180 AND e.Thrombosis = 0;

b.request: Count distinct patient IDs with at least one Laboratory record where GLU < 180 and at least one Examination record where Thrombosis = 0.
b.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient AS p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory AS l WHERE l.ID = p.ID AND l.GLU < 180) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Examination AS e WHERE e.ID = p.ID AND e.Thrombosis = 0);
b.raw: Count distinct patient IDs with at least one Laboratory record where GLU < 180 and at least one Examination record where Thrombosis = 0.
